《轮回修仙传》是一款以无限流多周目轮回式的修仙玩法为主的RPG游戏，玩家将一次次重生获得不同的初始能力，在快速而短暂的一生中进行修炼，继而获得各种能力的加成，并体验各种事件与不同的修仙一生。 游戏的基础玩法非常简单，就是通过鼠标点击各种不同的事件来触发剧情。游戏以年度为行动单位，每次的行动基本上就会花费一年的时间，部分奇遇或是情缘事件则不会推进时间。因为主人公拥有寿命，所以玩家在一个轮回内能够推进的事件数量其实也不是很多。而且在经历一些关键的战斗中如果因为能力没有跟上命丧黄泉，则有可能更早地结束这次轮回。玩家通过经历事件可以改变人物的属性，在进入山门之后每年都可以在修炼、炼丹、炼器和下山试炼中选择，会额外获得技能、丹药和装备法宝的机会。 游戏的过程中也会触发一些战斗事件，游戏的战斗采用的是自走棋的形式，玩家只需要养成好自己的属性，并且将装备、法宝装好，再将法术按照顺序排列释放即可直接进入战斗。再战斗之前玩家可以稍微查看敌人的基础信息，同时还有与对方战斗的胜率如何，玩家可以通过在战斗之前嗑药来获得一些临时的属性加成，帮助玩家在战斗中获得优势，并有更高的几率赢得战斗。部分战斗是比试的形式，战斗的胜负只会影响一些人物属性和关系等等，而有一些战斗则是非常致命的，如果玩家战斗失败则会直接导致人物死亡结束当前轮回。因此在有限的时间内，玩家需要花费时间来培养人物，才能有机会达成好的结局。 在轮回的过程中，玩家可以选择加入两个敌对而不同的山门，可以结识不同的关键人物，但是经历的事件有很高的相似度，只有一些关键剧情中会有差别。玩家可以在每个轮回中选择不同的经历从而达成不同的结局。 当玩家在游玩的过程中进行一些事件可以获得轮回点数，在结束一场轮回之后，则可以使用轮回点数增加一些局外成长，让主人公的初始属性获得提升，在接下来的轮回中获得更加强力的属性点数。 [table][td][b]欢迎关注我们 [/b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/10591434/]突突突发糖辣！[/url] [/td][/table]

Prioritize Fateful Encounters and Strange Encounters: The choices for fateful encounters and strange encounters in the game usually do not take up the in-game year time. When taking actions, it is recommended to prioritize clicking on the fateful encounter cards and strange encounter cards before arranging regular actions like cultivation and alchemy. This can more efficiently improve attributes and favorability. • Attribute Planning is Core: The fateful encounter events have specific requirements for attributes like Speed, Physique, Spirit Power, and Comprehension. For example, "Paper Kite Message" in Year 21 requires 50 Speed, and "Join Forces to Subdue the Demon" in Year 55 requires as high as 950 Spirit Power. These side stories not only have exciting plots but can also provide rare items, attribute rewards, and even affect the final outcome, making them worth exploring. Reincarnation: Immortal Tales reimagines the xianxia cultivation journey as a cycle of life, death, and renewal, emphasizing deliberate choices and long-term planning over open-world wandering. Instead of casting you as a lone cultivator roaming vast landscapes, the game frames your progression as a series of lifetimes, each run representing another attempt to refine your destiny. What begins as a humble mortal life quickly grows into a layered narrative of spiritual ascension, sect politics, emotional entanglements, and cosmic trials. Each reincarnation becomes both a reset and an opportunity, and the rhythm of repetition feeds directly into the game’s core fantasy: the pursuit of immortality through persistence, wisdom, and resilience. At its mechanical core, the game blends roguelike structure with cultivation systems familiar to fans of the genre. You spend each lifetime cultivating arts, refining alchemy, forging magical tools, forming bonds with allies or rivals, and preparing for inevitable calamities—major events or battles that often decide your fate. Failure is common, sometimes abrupt, and sometimes frustrating, but never final. Dying simply propels you into the next cycle, returning with reincarnation points you can invest into stronger foundations for future runs. This design encourages experimentation: when one path fails, another may flourish; when a particular school or elemental affinity proves too limiting, a new life offers a clean slate. Each run is shaped by meaningful decisions rather than exploration-heavy gameplay. Instead of roaming continents or engaging in real-time battles, you navigate branching events, character encounters, and cultivation milestones that define your trajectory. Over time, these interlocking decisions can lead to drastically different outcomes—ranging from traditional ascension endings to darker paths involving demonic cultivation, forbidden arts, or complex relationship routes. The game supports more than ten main endings and numerous variations tied to companions, sect allegiances, and personal philosophy, giving it considerable replay value for players who enjoy narrative experimentation. The visual design is functional but atmospheric, leaning heavily into the artistic conventions of Chinese fantasy. Stylized portrait art, elegant interface elements, and clear iconography support the text-centric experience without overwhelming the senses. While it lacks high-end 3D environments or animated battles, the presentation suits its identity as a cultivation life-sim with roguelike structure. It remains readable and aesthetically consistent, keeping your attention focused on choices, upgrades, and strategic planning. What makes the game compelling is how tightly its systems reinforce its themes. Cultivation in fiction often emphasizes introspection, slow progress, setbacks, and enlightenment gained through hardship—and this gameplay loop captures that spirit. Each reincarnation feels like a reflection on past failures: you return wiser, more prepared, and more determined to overcome trials that once seemed insurmountable. Over multiple lifetimes, your character evolves not just statistically but narratively, becoming a figure molded by triumphs, regrets, and accumulated insight. However, the game’s strengths also define its limits. Players who crave open-world adventure, real-time combat, or immersive environmental storytelling may find its structure restrictive. Much of the experience plays out through menus, choices, and text-driven events rather than exploration or action. The game favors introspective pacing and decision-making over spectacle, which may disappoint those expecting a dynamic world with NPC interactions, sect politics in motion, or visual dramatizations of cultivation breakthroughs. The repetition inherent in its reincarnation structure can also feel monotonous for players who prefer forward momentum rather than cyclical progress. Even so, for fans of life-simulation roguelikes and cultivation-themed storytelling, Reincarnation: Immortal Tales offers a focused and rewarding interpretation of xianxia mythology. It embraces the philosophical roots of the genre, emphasizing perseverance through countless lives and the idea that every failure is a stepping stone on the road to immortality. With its branching narrative paths, varied cultivation options, and deeply replayable structure, it becomes a meditative but engaging journey—one defined not by sprawling worlds, but by the intimate, cumulative evolution of a character striving to transcend fate itself. Rating: 8/10

太容易腻了。局外其实点出战斗反悔的天赋，再随便加点生命速度体魄啥的就够用了。再点个符箓，打BOSS一通贴，谁都能秒了。大大提高通关率，一会儿就腻了。作为一个肉鸽游戏，不可能靠“随机”事件来留住玩家，因为事件是人想出来的，而想出来的事情一定很有限。肉鸽是作者提供机制，主要由玩家来思考能怎么玩，那么这样就大大增加可能性和游玩持久度。轮回修仙的情况是技能大差不差，木火土金水有啥很大区别吗，没有。炼器的装备多吗？不多。装备和技能之间的联动有吗？没有。丹药和装备之间的联动有吗？没有。三个主要系统之间没有联系，各自为政，何来可能性？何来组合？何来无限的想象空间？丹药叠数值，装备也叠数值，技能要么盯着一系拿，要么无所谓乱拿，因为丹药装备的数值已经够变态了。总结下来就是轮回修仙传是个没有重复游玩价值的伪肉鸽游戏。

建议改名叫《轮回配种传》 不推荐 👎 真是开了眼了。我以为我在玩修仙RPG，结果玩了个低配版、逻辑崩坏的劣质黄油。 整个游戏的驱动力就在裤裆里。别的修仙游戏是炼丹、炼器、悟道；这个游戏是“破处”、“双修”、“3P”。怎么着，作者对修仙的理解就是靠生殖器征服世界？ 最搞笑的是，既然你要搞黄色，你就做得彻底点去卖H游；既然你要做修仙，就好好做玩法。这种夹在中间、又当又立、剧情稀烂的缝合怪，除了恶心人没有任何价值。 退款了，晦气。

To be perfectly honest, I wasn't really sure what a cultivation game was all about. So, I decided to give "轮回修仙传" (Reincarnation Immortal Cultivation Legend) a try! First, you will notice that this game does NOT have English subtitles but good news is that Alseyra has provided the English subtitles and the update (as of February 15th), was updated back on January 20th (so fairly recent). https://discord.com/channels/677466483458310144/1460961774630342708 And you just open it and replace the BepInEx file. EZ-PZ. As for the game, again, I've never played a cultivation game before but once I got into it, starting as a boy prodigy, you have the choice to influence how this kid grows up. Be wreckless, train in the martial arts, find romance with your childhood friend. But do know that the path will lead you to having to grow yourself and at first, you may not know what you are doing but that's fine. It's part of the process of doing something different each time. You die, you reincarnate but you keep your knowledge and certain skills and each time you come back, you are better. And those points after each playthrough can be invested. And that is what makes this game so addicting. So many paths too choose by the decisions you make. But the game is truly addicting. You want to play over and over because it's that much fun! But would like to give props to Collider Studio. As more and more Chinese games are released on STEAM and with the fan support for English subtitles (and the tough task for these smaller studios of having to use machine translation as they are small staffed), I'm definitely supportive of this company now after playing this game and I look forward to what they have to bring next. Even a sequel would be nice! Highly recommended!

[h1]我命由我不由天——《轮回修仙传》[/h1] 作为刚刚出生的abc，你出生在一个家族之中，每天会产生三张卡牌，有着不同事件，游玩、干活、练功等。 你的每一个决定，都可以提升你相关属性。 而偶尔产生的一个额外事件，将会给你带来加成或者奇遇。 玩着玩着，有一个和好朋友的故事，每天我只想和林小叶一起出去玩。 事情发生到一定阶段，林小叶加入了灵剑宗，而我没有继续前往， 在战胜前往林小叶家中袭击的黑衣人后，主角奄奄一息，一位神秘人救了我，顺势加入了逆天门。 每天做的就是修炼、炼丹、炼器或者历练。 同样是增加你的各种属性，如果你的某些属性不够，是不能触发特殊事件的。 游戏到达一定程度，你的宿命就来了，将会遭遇一个神秘的怪物，说实话，前期怎么打都打不过。 往往都是gg，游戏体验极差。 但是，游戏的核心，并不是当你体验单一一把的，失败后，你就自动进入轮回。 而游戏的重中之重，就是轮回天赋，你可以利用每一次失败后获得点数。 来升级相关天赋，让你变得更加强大。 同样，你所遭遇的剧情又会一遍一遍的重现，你就可以提前规避风险，逢凶化吉了。 整体体验下来，《轮回修仙传》作为一款以修仙为题材的多结局多周目轮回式Roguelike人生模拟类游戏。 题材很新颖，但是轮回多了，让你在前期剧情上有些枯燥，整体评价一般推荐！ [quote]关注「[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/45531088] 鸢尾花 [/url]」[/quote] [u][b] 致那一朵未至鸢尾花 [/b][/u]
